description: Evolve an EXISTING custom data table's schema: add columns, change existing ones (rename/retype — destructive for stored rows, use sparingly), or drop columns. The table is identified by its kebab-case name from list_custom_tables. Tables are ORG-WIDE, so a schema change lands for every flow and station already using this one — check who reads it before reshaping. NEVER rename or reshape a table a selfPersisting blueprint reads/writes — its copied code references the exact current names. Per-operation failures are collected rather than aborting the whole change. Row data itself stays a runtime concern of the generated app (renderClient).

referenceLinkedCollection.description: Foreign-key target collection (e.g. another custom table's kebab-case name).

referenceLinkedField.description: Foreign-key target field within that collection.

hubToken.description: Organization JWT fallback, only if the hub rejects your API key for this route.

removeFields.description: Columns to drop (destructive: their data is removed).

tableName.description: The existing table's kebab-case name (see list_custom_tables).

newName.description: Rename (orphans row data stored under the old key).

name: flow_update_custom_table
title: Change a custom table's schema
